# Security Policy

## Supported versions

dormduri has not published a production release yet. No released version currently receives a guaranteed security-support
window, but reports affecting the current repository or a test deployment are reviewed.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public GitHub issue containing vulnerability details, exploit code, credentials, personal data, or private service
information.

Send a private report to **woohyun365@gmail.com** with:

- the affected surface and observed version or commit;
- prerequisites and minimal reproduction steps;
- expected security impact;
- whether any account, personal data, or service availability was affected;
- a proposed mitigation, if known.

Do not access another person's data, degrade service availability, retain or exfiltrate data, or expand testing beyond the minimum
needed to demonstrate the issue. Coordinate any public disclosure with the repository owner.

This independent project does not currently promise a fixed response or remediation time, CVE assignment, or monetary bug bounty.
Acknowledgement and disclosure timing are handled case by case.

## Non-sensitive defects

Ordinary bugs without a security or privacy impact may use the regular issue workflow. When uncertain, use the private reporting
channel above.
